claim: No figure draws a title or a caption into the illustration, which the venue forbids, and every sentence that used to be drawn is returned for the legend from the same source.
status_note: All six carried a title drawn into the image and figure 2 carried a two-line explanatory caption along its bottom edge. Figures 5 and 6 also carried descriptive panel titles, and figure 5's contradicted its own figure title: the panel said the Jaccard was stable under dicom-validator while the figure said it was not stable under either reading.
value: 6 of 6 figures draw no title; 6 of 6 return one for the legend; the two descriptive panel-title pairs in figures 5 and 6 are panel letters a and b
floor: not applicable, this row reports a property of the figure set and not a validator rate
dropped: in-plot annotations that label a graphical element are kept and are not treated as captions: figure 3's key to the rule line, figure 4's mass labels and figure 5's V9 annotation. A figure that cannot be read without them is not improved by moving them to a legend

claim: Every text colour used in the figures clears the contrast ratio the venue requires, computed from the colours the figures draw with rather than asserted.
status_note: The submission checklist carried this as manual and not measured, and it was the one manual row that was failing. Two pairings were below the minimum.
value: 88 text pairings logged, lowest 5.10 to 1, against a required 4.5 to 1. The two that failed before this was computed: white on the medium grey fill of figure 1 at 1.98, and the light accent on white in figure 4 at 3.54.
floor: not applicable, this row reports a rendering property and not a validator rate
dropped: only text is checked. Fill against fill, and the distinguishability of the accent from the grey for a reader with a colour vision deficiency, are not measured here and no claim is made about them
notes: The confusion-matrix cells choose their text colour from the cell's own colour rather than from a threshold on the value, because a fixed threshold across a sequential colormap puts white on a mid-tone at about 3 to 1.

claim: No figure is drawn wider than the venue's text column, so production does not scale the lettering below the stated minimum.
status_note: Five of the six were over. Figure 3 was drawn at 366 mm against a 174 mm column, so it would have been scaled to 48 percent and its 8 pt values would have printed at 3.8 pt.
value: 6 of 6 figures at 174.0 mm; before this was checked, figure 1 was 174, figure 4 193, figures 2 and 6 213, figure 5 244 and figure 3 366
floor: not applicable, this row reports a rendering property and not a validator rate
dropped: figure 3 had to be rebuilt rather than rescaled: at the column width its carrier labels ran into the first value column, its analysis-result names overlapped, and the key to its rule sat on top of a data row. The value truncation is now 17 characters rather than 28, so more strings are clipped, and every clip is still marked with an ellipsis

claim: The version column of the recoverability ladder carries a version, and the string it was found in is published beside it.
status_note: It carried the whole string the version was found in, clipped at forty characters, so the TotalSegmentator row printed a SeriesDescription cut mid-phrase where a reader expects a version. Both are kept because the token alone loses the build suffix in a value like 2.3:Win64_072712 and the string alone is not a version.
value: 4 of 31 cells carry a version. totalsegmentator_ct_segmentations now reads v1.5.6, found in TotalSegmentator(v1.5.6) Segmentation of Series 5; the three qiba_volct_1b cells read 2.3, found in 2.3:Win64_072712
floor: not applicable, this row reports a published value rather than a validator rate
dropped: nothing; the count of cells carrying a version is unchanged, only what the column prints

claim: What the caller writes into SoftwareVersions on highdicom-written objects, measured rather than asserted. It is a repository URL on a quarter of them and nothing at all on the rest.
status_note: Table 4's caption said a repository URL was present on all 1,001 highdicom-written objects. That clause was wrong twice: 1,001 is the Segmentation subset of 7,100, and the value is not present on all of them. The caption is now computed from this row rather than typed.
value: 7,100 highdicom-written objects: 1,788 carry a conversion-pipeline repository URL, being Segmentation 1,001, Parametric Map 691 and Comprehensive 3D SR 96; the remaining 5,312 carry an empty SoftwareVersions and every one of those is a Comprehensive 3D SR
floor: not applicable, this row counts attribute values and not validator findings
dropped: nothing; every object in the measured set whose ImplementationVersionName begins with highdicom was counted
validator: none, this row reads recorded values
notes: The corrected figure is a sharper version of the paper's own finding rather than a retreat from it. SoftwareVersions is Type 1 under Enhanced General Equipment, which the Segmentation and Parametric Map IODs include, and Type 3 in General Equipment, which is all the Comprehensive 3D SR IOD has. Where the standard compels a non-empty value the caller supplies one and it names a conversion pipeline; where it does not, the caller supplies nothing.

claim: The rule-ordering undercount recorded at FIG-03 is disclosed in the manuscript, with its worked example and the direction it runs in.
status_note: It was recorded in the ledger and appeared nowhere in Results, Limitations or the section listing what is not reported. As shipped, a reader comparing figure 3's third column with table 3 found a flat contradiction and no explanation.
value: Results 3.2.1b carries the disclosure with tcga_sbu_til_maps as the worked example, 470 of 470 non-MANUAL segments with a complete macro naming Stony Brook TIL Segmentation Inception-V4 2022, classified institution before any producer rule is reached; 3.6 and 3.7 carry it in short
floor: not applicable, this row reports a disclosure rather than a measurement
dropped: nothing is reclassified. Moving a rule to catch these two would be adjudicating our own result, and the rule table and its residual are published so a reader can overrule the call
notes: Reclassifying both would move the lead result from 21 of 31 cells to 19 of 31 and would raise the informative rate, so the rule table is conservative against this paper's own finding.
